mods.name: docker-guard
mods.description: Asks before Docker commands that delete data: system, volume or image prune, rm -f, volume rm and compose down -v.

mods.name: k8s-guard
mods.description: Asks before kubectl apply or replace with --force, kubectl drain, helm uninstall, and kubectl delete behind global flags (plain kubectl delete is infra-guard's).

mods.name: migration-guard
mods.description: Asks before Write or Edit changes a migration that already exists; new migration files pass.

mods.name: ci-config-guard
mods.description: Asks before Write or Edit changes CI config: .github/workflows, .gitlab-ci.yml or .circleci/config.yml.

mods.name: chmod-guard
mods.description: Asks before chmod makes files world-writable (777, a+w, o+w) or chmod or chown runs recursively on a broad path (/, a system folder, a home folder).

mods.name: git-history-guard
mods.description: Asks before git commands that throw away work or rewrite history: reset --hard, clean, rebase, filter-branch, filter-repo, push --delete, branch -D and stash clear.

mods.name: big-file-guard
mods.description: Asks before a Write creates content over 1 MB, or git add names a file over 5 MB. Measures the files with find.

mods.name: guard-devops
mods.description: Asks before harsh DevOps commands: destructive Docker, Kubernetes and Helm calls, CI config edits, broad chmod and chown, and git commands that lose work. Add infra-guard for plain kubectl delete.
